master_sword.name: Master Sword
notes: Canonical Master silhouette rebuilt with cutting bevels, fuller, layered wing guard, gemstone setting, grip wrap and Triforce.
Reflection bands use the game-supported G_TEXTURE_GEN material, not an image overlay.
Steel blade, blue-violet metal hilt and leather grip, golden central gem.

true_master_sword.name: True Master Sword
notes: Canonical Master silhouette rebuilt with cutting bevels, fuller, layered wing guard, gemstone setting, grip wrap and Triforce.
Reflection bands use the game-supported G_TEXTURE_GEN material, not an image overlay.
Level-four pigments: blade #E0A800, white hilt/grip #F8F8F8, gem #4870D0.

gilded_sword.name: Gilded Sword
notes: Native Gilded identity retained: forked violet guard, red grip, silver pommel and three gold blade diamonds.
Three physical tempered-gold inlays sit in recessed blade pockets and have independent reflection materials.

great_fairy_sword.name: Great Fairy Sword
notes: Rebuilt rose-metal blade, lilac lily fittings, emerald field and sculpted leaves/floral ornament.
All blade, handle and ornament surfaces are opaque; no enlarged low-resolution black/green motif is used.
Art interpretation pending user review; shimmer code and colors remain untouched.

kokiri_sword.name: Kokiri Sword (OoT)
notes: OoT Kokiri identity: short steel blade, solid brown guard, red jewel, leather grip and flared wooden pommel.
Clean walnut guard without added wire ornament; mirrored bevel faces point outward and the blade tang extends through its central mount.

mm_kokiri_sword.name: Kokiri Sword (MM)
notes: MM Kokiri identity: broad clipped steel blade, rounded brass bar guard with two recessed fasteners, pale wrapped grip and violet pommel.
Rebuilt beveled steel, machined guard rims and grip fittings; continuous blade tang passes into the guard and upper grip.

four_sword.name: Four Sword
notes: Four Sword follows the user-supplied reference: curved gold guard with three integral recessed bands, round red ruby, ivory cloth grip and circular blue/gold Triforce pommel.
No dangling cloth tails. Blade tang and forked collar join continuously; reflective steel and gold are real exported materials.
